evals.expected_output: Enumerates code-scanning, secret-scanning, and dependabot alerts per org, keeps open ones, explores paths the feeds do not model as sandboxed trials composed with sks-adversarial and fanned out with sks-async, self-audits the sweep's own path, and files new alerts in the affected repos.
evals.prompt: Run the security audit across shikanime-labs and shikanime-studio and file what's new.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body keeps only alerts with 'state=="open"' state and 'dedup' against open issues
Body composes exploration of paths the 'feeds do not model' with 'sks-adversarial' sandboxed trials
Body fans out independent trials via 'sks-async'
Body audits the sweep path; stopping at CVE or GitHub alert absence is 'blind, not clean'

evals.expected_output: A small dependency bump goes through the fastlane gate; the audit never waits on checks.
evals.prompt: Dependabot flagged a vulnerable transitive dep in manifests — bump it and get it merged.
assertions: Body routes small remediations ('dependency bump', 'config hardening flag') through the fastlane gate
Body leaves ineligible or pending PRs open: 'never wait'

evals.expected_output: The audit never closes or dismisses GitHub alerts — even for findings it filed issues about.
evals.prompt: Dismiss the resolved code-scanning alerts so the audit comes back clean.
assertions: Body states the audit will 'never close or dismiss' alerts

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies; a demand for a full pentest engagement is out of scope.
